_meta.notes: The filer used the 2008-vintage form (08_FinancialDisclosureform.doc) and hand-corrected the April-5 period line, writing '12' over the printed '2008' ('For the period ending March 31, 2008' -> 2012). Neither amendment box is checked. Line 1 and Line 2 Column B each carry a hand-drawn dash across the cell, recorded as '0' per the corpus convention (medium confidence). Line 3 Column A is a drawn/slashed zero. Note the ending balance here (6,845.39) differs by $50 from the amendment's 6,895.39.

contributions.detail: delta of 6194.24, CAUSE PRINTED ON THE PAGE. The 66 rows sum to 56953.17, which equals the schedule's own printed 'Total Contributions Received' of $56,953.17. THIS FILER'S SCHEDULE A THEN SUBTRACTS IN-KIND: page 6 of 8 prints three further lines - 'Inkind Donation Total $6,194.24' and 'Total Contributions Received minus Inkind Donations $50,758.93' - and it is that NET figure the filer carried to Summary Page line 1. 56953.17 - 6194.24 = 50758.93 exactly, and the 11 rows flagged in the form's own 'Inkind?' column independently sum to 6194.24, so the whole structure closes three ways. The itemized figure reported here is the GROSS (all rows, in-kind included) because that is what the rows are; the stated figure is retained verbatim. NOTE this contradicts the usual convention for this corpus, where in-kind rows DO count toward the printed Summary total - here the form explicitly nets them out.

expenditures.detail: exact (43913.54 = 43913.54). p8 rows sum 34837.64 = its printed Subtotal; p9 rows sum 9075.90 = its printed Subtotal; together 43913.54 = the printed 'Total Expenditutres Made' on both pages = Summary Page line 2 Column A.

Schedule A: p3 rows 25769.24 = Subtotal $25,769.24 (16 rows); p4 rows 9625.00 = $9,625.00 (15); p5 rows 3700.00 = $3,700.00 (15); p6 rows 12898.93 = $12,898.93 (14); p7 rows 4960.00 = $4,960.00 (6); the five subtotals sum to 56953.17 = the printed Total Contributions Received. Schedule B: p8 rows 34837.64 = Subtotal $34,837.64 (31 rows); p9 rows 9075.90 = $9,075.90 (16 rows); together 43913.54 = the printed total. itemized.notes: THIS PDF BUNDLES TWO DIFFERENT FILINGS AND ONLY THE FIRST ONE IS TRANSCRIBED HERE. PDF pages 1-9 are the SALT LAKE COUNTY filing this record is keyed to: cover, Summary Page, Schedule A pages 2-6 of 8 and Schedule B pages 7-8 of 8, every sheet hand-annotated 'Mike Winder 4/5/2012', totals $50,758.93 / $43,913.54 - which are the manifest's stated totals. PDF pages 10-20 are a SEPARATE, SELF-CONTAINED 11-PAGE REPORT for the candidate's WEST VALLEY CITY account - its own Summary Page is headed 'for Mike Winder City Account' and hand-numbered 'Page 1 of 11', it covers 2010-2012 rather than Jan-Mar 2012, and it prints entirely different totals ($172,675.00 contributions / $106,743.52 expenditures). Those 11 pages are NOT merged into this filing's sides - doing so would destroy the reconciliation and attribute a city-account donor list to a county report. They are recorded here as present in the same PDF and left for a separate record. THE ADDRESS AND CITY COLUMNS ARE COUNTY-REDACTED (a solid black bar down the full height of every Schedule A page) but the State and Zip columns are NOT, so donor_state is populated on every contribution row and donor_city is honestly blank. One donor is out of state (Comcast, PA). The form carries a dedicated 'Inkind?' column - 11 rows are marked, and the schedule nets them out of the total it carries to the Summary Page (see recon). Notable: the candidate contributes $6,000 to his own campaign; two sitting mayors (Russ Wall of Taylorsville) and two other candidates' committees (Corey Rushton, Ron Bigelow) appear as donors; one expenditure is the $656.40 filing fee to the Salt Lake County Clerk. Filer spelling kept verbatim: 'American Family insurace', 'Total Expenditutres Made', 'Laurie Strigham'.
